adoption.no_model_discovery_credit: The actual defect and design predated the model requests.

software.scope: Actual catalog custody and the new helper exercised with a generic nominal software family and exact operation grammar. Preparation, observer and replay callbacks throw if called; positive signed-domain cases, short-circuit rejection, issued-family identity and catalog-exception propagation checked.
software.not_verified: Actual domain target behavior in the loaded application, private issuer/writer preparation, natural execution, full family acceptance, Native/Game outcome or runtime performance.

clock_accounting.limit: Discovery, HTTP, review/takeover, classpath work, coordination/resource waits and verification are included in the full wall. HTTP requests overlap; sums and nested windows are not additive labor, CPU or service queue time.

The final test deliberately uses a generic software family; named ABI metadata checks do not grant actual domain-target or source-to-loaded-body verification.
comparison_limit: Complete stop and precise owner feedback did not make these candidates adoptable. This is a specific failure and owner takeover, not a permanent model limit, cross-mode comparison or net saving measurement.
next_real_trigger: Add an actual later publication or runtime receipt as a separate stage if it exists; route genuinely new typed or bounded tasks without replaying these rejected rounds.
